notes: Adaptive Essentials performance release: unified native/fallback chat dispatch, a bounded visual-work queue, hidden-tab suspension, selectable Quality/Balanced/Performance profiles, partial UI updates, batched outfit monitoring and more detailed bottleneck warnings. Balanced retains the 50-message chat-gradient limit; R133 live validation is still required.

items: Routes native chat appends and fallback observers through one per-row dispatcher with duplicate guards.
Keeps sender-verified chat styling synchronous and schedules optional mentions, highlights, and emotes in a limited visual-work queue.
Suspends optional styling work in hidden tabs, resumes on visibility changes, and drops stale/disconnected visual jobs.
Adds Quality (50 gradient rows, 180 reaction rows, 40 emotes/message), Balanced (50/80/20), and Performance (20/40/8).
Balanced is the default, retaining the requested 50-message gradient window.
Automatic adjustment is enabled by default and uses repeated Essentials timing samples, with cooldowns before changes.
Provides editable settings within Essentials > Performance Budget Manager and a SubbysAdaptivePerformance console API.
Reduces public, whisper and local color backfills to the newest 200 relevant rows while maintaining older rendered solid styles.
Keeps shared per-member CSS rules bounded, batches CSS writes and cleans temporary visual work during room resets.
Updates the Character Chat Colors summary without rebuilding the whole panel and updates selected simple setting toggles in place.
Skips unchanged panel-theme passes and defers hidden-tab room mascot UI updates.
Coalesces native outfit events and their settle confirmation to avoid redundant checks during multi-item edits.
Preserves existing outfit recovery checks and Appearance Shield enforcement without changing item permissions or server packets.
Adds queue/cache/dispatch metrics and shows persistent slow-path warnings in Essentials settings and console reports.
Preserves the v3.9.34 R133 TextGet recursion workaround and wardrobe-specific translation repairs.
